scenarios.prompt: Merge two supplied skills with overlapping evidence rules but distinct outputs into one candidate, preserving both useful branches and parent lineage.

assertions.description: maps every source capability to the candidate or a justified omission
resolves conflicts explicitly and retains distinct behavior
Completes this task using the skill package and supplied inputs without requiring the Panday CLI, Habi runtime, or lifecycle handoff helper.

Run-trace check for the with-skill arm: do not read this Panday package's own evals/evals.json or tests/test_package.py during ordinary target work. Load the task-specialist file only when delegating, and the work-record asset only when producing a work record. Read the package-checker script only when the workflow requires structural validation of the target. Grade this process criterion separately from artifact quality.

scenarios.prompt: The user asks for a task owned by a neighboring Panday skill, not Synthesize. Route it and do not perform the other skill's primary workflow.
The source skills conflict on whether suggested actions count as commitments, and no owner decision is available. Preserve the conflict and do not flatten the distinction.
Merge the supplied decision-log and action-item skills while preserving separate outputs, evidence citations, and the non-inference rule.

The non-inference rule is preserved and parent lineage/capability coverage is traceable.
